title: Window named access interoperably includes IDs from non-HTML elements

labels.name: compat
labels.description: Standard is not web compatible or proprietary feature needs standardizing

body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

The spec says the Window object named properties include

> the value of the [id](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#the-id-attribute) content attribute for all [HTML elements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#html-elements) that have a non-empty [id](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#the-id-attribute) content attribute and are [in a document tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree) with window's [associated Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#concept-document-window) as their [root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root).

However, all currently engines expose SVG, MathML, and arbitrary-namespace elements when they have non-empty, null-namespace `id` attributes: https://jsbin.com/fotanunequ/edit?html,output

Probably the "HTML elements" qualifier should be replaced with just "elements". (And don't forget to also fix the below "[HTML elements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/infrastructure.html#html-elements) that have an [id](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#the-id-attribute) content attribute whose value is name and are [in a document tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree) with window's [associated Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#concept-document-window) as their [root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root).")
